claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Metoprolol is a hydrophilic beta-1-selective adrenergic antagonist that is not cytotoxic at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and attributable to non-specific beta-blockade or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a dominant cytotoxic mechanism.
